clue.text: Retired FBI agent sued criminal and cooled down

indicators.note: someone retired has withdrawn or gone back, so the agent's word is read backwards

parts.note: a fed is American slang for an agent of the FBI

indicators.note: criminal suggests something crooked or bent out of shape, so the letters of sued get rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A former FBI agent, accused in court, calms down after the lawsuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' looks like a description of the agent, but it is the instruction to read the agent's slang name backwards; fed is American slang for a federal officer.
explanation.definitionFit: To defuse a tense situation is to calm it, taking the heat out of it, so the past tense matches.

clue.text: U-boat's leader found floating in European river

indicators.note: something floating in a liquid sits inside it, so these letters go within the other word

parts.note: a Dane is a native of Denmark
the letter taken as written from U-boat

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its front, so only the opening letter of boat counts

parts.note: first letter of boat

explanation.surface: A German submarine's commander turns up drifting in one of Europe's great rivers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'U-boat's leader' gives two letters, U and then the head of boat, which sit inside DANE to make DANUBE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Danube is the long waterway flowing from Germany through Vienna and Budapest to the Black Sea.

clue.text: Glib line about a Catholic

indicators.note: about means going round, so the first word's letters wrap around the rest

parts.note: a file is a line of people one behind another
taken as written
C is the standard abbreviation for Catholic

explanation.surface: A smooth-talking remark made about someone of the Catholic faith.

clue.text: Naughty priestess capturing the heart of brother's relative

explanation.walkthrough: 'Brother's relative' looks like the whole definition, but 'brother' also supplies its central letter, so only 'relative' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A stepsister is a female kin member acquired through a parent's remarriage, so she is family by marriage.

clue.text: Discourage 50% of firm

explanation.definitionFit: To deter someone is to put them off doing something, which is to dishearten or dissuade them.

clue.text: Distance covered by very large fruit

clue.text: In trouble with the bank, somehow Dave won right to cross river

explanation.surface: Dave somehow earned the right to cross the river, though his bank account is in the red.
explanation.walkthrough: DAVE WON with R for right is rearranged, and the R for river sits inside to make OVERDRAWN. 'with' joins definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An overdrawn account has had more taken out than it held, the usual way a customer gets into difficulty with a lender.

clue.text: A cold leads to horrible ear pain

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a dull continuous hurt, a close synonym for a bodily discomfort.

clue.text: Complained after German found out

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for German
to be rumbled is British slang for being found out

explanation.surface: Someone moaned once a German discovered the truth.
explanation.walkthrough: To rumble someone is British slang for seeing through them or discovering their secret.
explanation.definitionFit: Grumbled means moaned or muttered discontentedly, a near synonym for voicing a grievance.

clue.text: Watch flood outside European court

clue.text: New husband wearing diamonds in a corner

explanation.definitionFit: To abet is to assist or encourage, usually wrongdoing, so it is a verb synonym for assist.

clue.text: He gets badly treated hair in the garden by the Mount of Olives

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: Unrelated means having no kinship or connection, so it describes someone not part of a given household.

clue.text: Monopolise hut containing a beer barrel

taken as written

clue.text: Pays for female setter to visit Cannes for a change

the French resort, taken as written to be rearranged

clue.text: Wrens managed to eat the last bit of hazelnut spread
